stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: I typed twelve, and it all stopped.

stations.title: Hut desk
stations.text: Stops at the first typing slip

captions: The hut desk at a busy hour. Bridie types twelve in words, and wants the desk to cope.
Today one typing slip stops the whole program, and the queue waits.
You catch the exceptions a slip brings, and only those, where they can happen.
Now a slip gets an answer, and the desk goes on to the next ticket.
Slips answered, mistakes still found. Next, the desk refuses what cannot be.
